description:
Subject: Configuration Summary for Kafka REST Proxy and Schema Registry  

The Kafka REST proxy is set up to use the **GSSAPI** SASL mechanism with the client security protocol **SASL_SSL**. It will connect to the two brokers at `SASL_SSL://kafka-broker-0.example.com:9092` and `SASL_SSL://kafka-broker-1.example.com:9092`. The client’s Kerberos service name remains the default **kafka**, but Kerberos authentication is currently **disabled**. The associated secrets are named **jaas-secret** (JAAS configuration), **__dcos_base64___keytab_example** (keytab), and **krb5-conf-secret** (krb5 config). Zookeeper is addressed via `master.mesos:2181/dcos-service-confluent-kafka`.  

The Schema Registry service, identified as **schema‑registry**, runs under the user **schema_user** on the **analytics** role. It is allocated **2 CPU shares**, **1 GB of memory**, and a JVM heap of **512 MB**. The listener is configured for **HTTPS** on the default port, using the keystore secret **keystore-secret** and the cipher suites `TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384`. Client authentication over SSL is required. HTTP CORS settings allow the methods **GET, POST, PUT, DELETE** from any origin (`*`). The service is deployed in the **dcos** virtual network, which is enabled, and the network plugin receives two labels: `env=prod` and `team=data-platform`. Its Zookeeper namespace for persistence is `dcos-service-confluent-kafka/schema-registry`. Only a single instance of the registry is planned.
